exposure: Oocyte source for ART pregnancies (autologous vs. donor)
ART singleton pregnancies (autologous oocytes vs. donor oocytes)
cohort: 472 women aged 45 years or older who delivered at a tertiary care medical center
finding: Very advanced maternal age (vAMA) women who conceived with ART were more likely to be white, older, primiparous, and undergo elective CD and experience retained placenta compared to vAMA women with spontaneous conceptions.
mod_finding: Very advanced maternal age women (over 45 years old) who conceived via assisted reproductive technologies were significantly more likely to have a cesarean delivery than those who conceived spontaneously.
